scripts.format: prettier --write src tests docs README.md package.json vite.config.js index.html scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests package.json vite.config.js index.html scripts/serve.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && node scripts/mobile-package.mjs && cap sync
scripts.mobile:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
scripts.mobile:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:build:ios: npm run mobile:sync && xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath .native-build/ios CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
